title: 0208 - the A1 face interval is SHARPENED in-tree: [2.490066528, 6.0162) (from [.., 7)). Sharp frontier brackets log 3e10 < 24.2 (finsum(24.2, 32) margin x1.0234) and log log 3e10 < 3.2 (finsum(3.2, 8) = 428771741/17578125 > 24.2) retire the coarse 25/4 pins; pin_explicit_3e10_sharp: G_explicit 3e10 < 30081/5000 = 6.0162 (true value 6.0032 - within 0.013 of sharp); wire constant sharpens from < 17 to < 15. No RH claim
body: 0208 tightens the 0207 face quantification to near-sharp. (1) TransNums gains two sharp premise-free frontier brackets: log (3e10) < 242/10 = 24.2 - via 3e10 < finsum(242/10, 32) (exact 65/55-digit rational, margin x1.0234) + expFinsum_le_exp; and log (log 3e10) < 32/10 = 3.2 - via log 3e10 < 24.2 < exp (3.2), with finsum(32/10, 8) = 428771741/17578125 ≈ 24.3945 > 24.2 (margin x1.0079). Both exact-rational norm_num. (2) A1Growth section 8: pin_explicit_3e10_sharp proves G_explicit (3e10) < (111/1000)(24.2) + (275/1000)(3.2) + 2.45 = 30081/5000 = 6.0162 (premise-free; the true value 6.0032 to the eye - the pin sits within 0.013 of the sharp value, i.e. the face upper end is now essentially the exact data-free certificate); pin_explicit_wire_3e10_sharp: (G + 1)(17/8) < 15 (from < 17 at the 0207 pin; exact step value 596377/40000 = 14.909425); pin_face_S_sharp_3e10: the measured |S| frontier pin 2.490066528 < 6.0162. Hence the quantified face interval at the 3e10 frontier - any absolute K dominating |S| on the measured domain must lie in [2.490066528, 6.0162), S-side, both ends machine-checked with no premises, the single cited input of the whole lane still the Trudgian growth bound A1G-5. The gap to the absolute clause is unchanged in kind (the G-constantness, face_unbounded) and sharper in number. Note the chain of sharpenings 7 -> 6.1 (first attempt, REJECTED: (6.1+1)(17/8) = 15.0875 > 15 - the coarse 6.1 pin could not close the wire < 15, the exact-sum pin 6.0162 could): the discipline lesson is that the pin must be the EXACT bracketed sum, not a rounded cap, whenever a downstream strict inequality depends on it. Pinned-API lessons added: lt_of_lt_of_lt does not exist in this pin (use h1.trans h2); 242/10 and 121/5 are the same real - state brackets in ONE notation or simpa between them; calc continuation lines must be indented deeper than the calc keyword line (same-indent silently terminates the block). Builds: TransNums 8712 green; A1Growth 8713 green; full package green (tmp/build_0208.log). Discovery 0207 remains valid - 0208 refines, does not supersede. No RH claim: the face is NAMED, NOT CLOSED; hA1 remains the single open theorem of the A1 assembly.
